sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: MAD , the architecture studio founded by Ma Yansong , has revealed the designs for Danshuis, a new dance center planned for Rotterdam , the Netherlands . Located on a landmark site in the city's historic docklands, adjacent to the Fenix Museum of Migration , also designed by MAD , the project is expected to open in 2030. The 9,500-square-meter center will transform an Art Deco warehouse dating from 1923 on the south bank of the River Maas. Planned as a center for the production, development, and practice of dance across different styles, Danshuis aims to bring together professional and amateur programs for different ages and levels of experience.
